text:
fiona: Quick thread  want to finalize the community play for the OSS refapp: blog + 2 micro-tutorials + livestream. Need leadflow mapping and minimal form fields.
jake: Agreed. Sequence: short blog with two charts + repo CTA -> two emails with tiny tutorials (5-7 min vids) -> livestream signups.
maria: Lead routing: form -> HubSpot list 'oss-community' with tag 'refapp-launch-2026'. If repo zip downloaded, add property downloaded_refapp=true. If 'enterprise follow-up' checked route to sales queue.
of Oliver: I'll make the charts and a 10s GIF of a local run for socials. Bench quick take: batch+cache run on 4xA100: p50~120ms, p95~310ms, unit cost ~$0.001/token on our sample. I'll push PNGs to drive.
jake: Blog snippet to include (keep tiny):
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/refapp-oss.git
cd refapp-oss
./quickstart --model mosaic-small
```
maria: Form fields: name, email, company, role, use_case (dropdown), checkbox enterprise_contact, hidden utm fields. Also capture source=blog.
signup-bot: Event created: /events/refapp-launch-2026 on 2026-03-22T14:05Z
fiona: Timeline: blog draft due Mon noon, tutorials recorded Tue, livestream Thu. Social cadence: announcement + two reminder posts. A/B test headline variants and track repo clones + form completions.
jack: (typo) jake: will add the headline variants to #marketing-review.
oliver: Uploaded artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/oss-launch/2026-03-22 (acl: marketing, devrel). PNGs and GIFs there.
maria: HubSpot form set up, hidden field campaign=refapp_launch_2026, list created. Automation: if someone registers, send quickstart email with repo link immediately.
fiona: Perfect. Action items: oliver = visuals + GIFs (done), jake = code snippet + headline variants, maria = HubSpot form + automations, i'll own copy + PR. Flag blockers here. :rocket:
